display.interface_size_help: How large the menus, the editor and the tools are drawn. The battle interface keeps its own size.
display.language_help: The language of the interface. Words a language doesn't have yet are shown in English.

kit.title: Interface kit
kit.scripts_help: Panels drawn by Lua scripts (ui/*.lua in the game or a mod). Tick one to open it.
kit.regular: Regular: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog 0123456789
kit.bold: Semi-bold: headings and things that matter
kit.mono: Mono: for consoles, numbers in columns and code
kit.icons: {n|# icon|# icons}, drawn from the icon font at any size
kit.no_phases: This mission has no phases; a sample is shown.

kit.timeline_help: Drag items to move them (Alt: off the grid), their right edge to stretch them, the ruler to move the playhead. Ctrl+wheel zooms.
kit.graph_help: Drag a box to move it, the background to pan. The wheel zooms.
kit.fields_help: Every condition and action of the script registry, edited by the same panel the editor uses.
